'''Terrelian Jango Jumpers''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Terrelia/Legends|Terrelia]].

==Biology and description==
[[Color/Legends|Blue]]-skinned [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]], Terrelians were gifted with impressive physical abilities that made them natural athletes, including the ability to run at great speeds for long periods of time, and being able to jump vast distances,<ref name="NewBattlefronts" /> comparable to the [[Force jump/Legends|Force-enhanced jumps]] employed by members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].

==History==
One Terrelian, a [[Thief/Legends|thief]] by the name of [[Cassie Cryar/Legends|Cassie Cryar]], eluded and physically matched the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] while being chased through the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|underworld]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="LightsaberLost" />

Another member of the species, named [[Lika/Legends|Lika]], was hunted down and killed on [[Wasskah/Legends|Wasskah]] by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]] who hunted for sport.
